chunks: Three - Abdul Wahid ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus narrated: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qurashi narrated: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated, from Hammad ibn Abi Talha, from Abu Hamza al-Thimali, who said: Abu Ja'far said to me:

O Thabit, as if I see the Qa'im of my Ahl al-Bayt approaching this Najaf of yours. (He pointed with his hand towards the side of Kufa). When he approaches your Najaf, he will spread the banner of the Messenger of Allah. When he spreads it, the angels of Badr will descend upon him. I asked: What is the banner of the Messenger of Allah? He said: Its pole is from the poles of the Throne of Allah and His mercy, and the rest of it is from the victory of Allah. He does not swoop it down upon anything except that Allah destroys it. I asked: Is it kept hidden with you until the Qa'im arises, or is it brought to him? He said: No, but it is brought to him. I asked: Who brings it to him? He said: Gabriel.

key_terms.راية رسول الله: The Banner of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.نجف: Najaf (a high place or mound, referring to Kufa)

ai.seo_question: What is the origin and significance of the Prophet's banner in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir (as) foretells the appearance of the Qa'im in Kufa, emphasizing the divine origin of the Prophet’s banner whose pole is rooted in the Throne of Allah. The narration highlights the miraculous descent of the angels of Badr upon the banner's unfurling and clarifies that it is brought by Gabriel rather than remaining hidden, underscoring its tangible, celestial authority in the eschatological era.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (3) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah bin Younus narrated from Muhammad bin Ja’far al-Qarashi from Muhammad bin al-Husayn bin Abul Khattab from Muhammad bin Sinan from Hammad bin Abu Talha that Abu Hamza ath-Thimali had said: “Once Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) said to me: “O Thabit, as if I see al-Qa’im of my family coming near to your Najaf.” He pointed with his hand towards Kufa and then added: “When he comes to your Najaf, he will spread the banner of the Prophet (S) and then the angels of Badr will descend to him.” I asked him: “What is the banner of the Prophet (S)?” He said: “Its pole is from the pole of the Throne of Allah and from His mercy. The rest of it is from the assistance of Allah. Everything that he swoops on with this banner Allah will make it perish.” I said: “Is it kept with you until al-Qa’im (as) appears or it is brought then?” He said: “No. It is brought then.” I said: “Who brings it?” He said: “Gabriel (as).”
